title: LangChain messages casted to BaseMessage when passed to subgraph via Send arg
version: unknown (body lists langchain-core 0.3.66; no langgraph version)
observed_behavior: A parent node passes its state (containing a SystemMessage/HumanMessage) to a compiled subgraph through Send(goto='subgraph', arg=SubgraphState(**state.model_dump())). Inside the subgraph the message object has degraded to BaseMessage, so any code that relies on the concrete message class fails. The reporter traced this to BaseMessage not handling a dict with a 'type' value.
structure_focus: Message objects traversing a Send argument into a compiled subgraph; type information lost at the subgraph boundary
notes: Open, label-free. The issue body's snippet is malformed (Send(goto=Send(...))), but the follow-up comment gives the working shape: a parent node builds a pydantic SubgraphState and returns Command(goto=Send(node='subgraph', arg=SubgraphState(**state.model_dump()))). The fixture keeps the parent -> Send -> compiled subgraph boundary and records the observed class inside the child; the exact cast may not reproduce on every version. Classified framework because the reported change is a runtime type degradation during graph-boundary serialization, not a schema declaration mistake.
